latestVersion.changelog:
Initial release of office-web-slide: a browser-based HTML slide generator

- Generates interactive web slides (HTML) based on user-provided content and style preferences.
- Features a parallel "three-bucket" workflow guiding users to supply content, structure, and visual style.
- Offers 16 preset modern themes (8 styles × light/dark), advanced layouts, charts, and entrance animations.
- Strictly prevents metadata, user profiles, and sources from leaking into slide content.
- Includes a complete workflow: theme selection (visual picker), template-based HTML assembly, comprehensive visual QA, and split output for large slide decks.
- Supports data visualization (SVG, Chart.js, ECharts), localized theme customization, and component-based extension.
